name: The Maid of Honour
source:
Lady Violetta has always dreamed of becoming a beautiful bride.

But there are things she must give up in order to live the life of her dreams.

As her most trusted confidante- and as her maid of honour, it is your role to listen to all her worries and put them to rest. But that's not easy to do when it is your relationship with her that she has decided to give up on in order to live the life she's always wanted.

Accompany her on your final day together as she talks about the upcoming marriage. Listen to her thoughts, and her regrets.

And at the end of it all, learn to say goodbye.

[From [url=https://summerorigins.itch.io/maid-of-honour]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
维奥莱塔女士一直梦想成为一名美丽的新娘。

但为了过上梦想的生活，她必须放弃一些东西。

作为她最值得信赖的红颜知己和伴娘，你的职责就是倾听她所有的担忧并消除它们。但当她决定放弃你和她的关系以过上她一直想要的生活时，这并不容易。

在你们在一起的最后一天，陪伴她，听她谈论即将到来的婚姻。听听她的想法，以及她的遗憾。

最后，学会说再见。

[来自[url=https://summerorigins.itch.io/maid-of-honour]itch.io[/url]]
